text:
deploy-bot: Promotion of release v2026.11 to canary blocked by prompt-eval gate: 3/48 tests regressed (Q2 summarization, code-cls precision, hallucination-rate). Details: https://redwood-internal/evals/2026.11/summary :no_entry_sign:

sarah: saw the report, thanks. which model variant failed?

jonathan: Looks like the quantized-8bit variant (rwin-q8-v2) shows the spike. float16 hosted variant passed.

marta: important to know where in the pipeline — is this generation-level or post-filtering?

qa-bot: Quick snapshot:
```
Metric                baseline   current   delta
Q2-summary-F1         0.82       0.75      -0.07
Code-class-prec       0.91       0.84      -0.07
Hallucination-rate    0.03       0.08      +0.05
```

natalie: product note — this is user-visible for the docs summarizer feature. Not comfortable shipping regressions to canary users.

kevin: options: 1) pin canary to previous pinned variant (rwin-q8-v1), 2) rollback the on-host deploy (if any rolled already), 3) run targeted bisect across commits/quantization steps.

prashant: my hunch: quantization pipeline changed a kernel ordering that affects long-coherence contexts. We should bisect across quantization commits and also re-run the eval on a larger sample.

sarah: timeline: we are inside a 4-hour release window. We need a quick decision: pin or abort? If we pin, we should also open a follow-up to bisect and a clear owner.

jonathan: I can own the bisect. I recommend pinning canary to rwin-q8-v1 for the window, run a parallel bisect job that targets the quant pipeline. If bisect finds a cheap revert, we can re-promote this afternoon.

marta: agree. Also propose updating release notes with a short entry: "Canary hold: prompt-eval regression on q8 variant; investigating" — small PR to docs?

natalie: approve pin to previous variant. Please add me to the PR for final go/no-go.

deploy-bot: Action items created:
- TICKET-5492: pin canary to rwin-q8-v1 (assignee: jonathan)
- TICKET-5493: bisect quantization pipeline (assignee: jonathan)
- TICKET-5494: regen evals with expanded sample (assignee: prashant)

prashant: starting the regen eval job now, will post interim numbers ~30m

kevin: if regen eval passes, we need a manual product sign-off before we unblock. @natalie please confirm you can review within the window.

natalie: I can review in ~45m. Flag me when interim numbers posted.

sarah: summary decision: hold automated promotion, pin canary to rwin-q8-v1 for stability, start bisect/regression jobs, product review required for re-promote.

jonathan: executing pin now. will comment back with deploy-bot confirmation.

deploy-bot: Canary update: rwin-q8-v1 pinned at canary route. Automated promotion suspended until manual approval.

prashant: interim regen results (30m): Q2-summary-F1 -> 0.81, Code-class-prec -> 0.90, Hallucination-rate -> 0.035. Looks much closer to baseline.

natalie: thanks — that looks acceptable. once bisect completes, if it isolates to the quant patch and we have a safe revert, we can consider a re-promote this afternoon. for now, approve keeping canary pinned. :white_check_mark:

kevin: filing a short release note draft in the release repo under changelogs: "Canary hold: prompt-eval deviation observed in q8 quantized variant; canary pinned while investigations proceed." Jon, please add when you close the pin ticket.

jonathan: bisect job started; initial suspects narrowed to two commits. will try revert candidate on a staging replica and re-run evals, ETA 2h.

marta: thanks all. keeping this thread updated with major changes.

deploy-bot: Thread closed by policy: canary promotion disabled until manual approval.
